title: UK Golf Equipment Prices (Daily, GolfPrice AI)
subtitle: Lowest new UK prices and price history for 600+ golf clubs, balls and gear
description:
GolfPrice AI checks UK golf equipment prices across multiple UK retailers every 6 hours and keeps its own price history for each model. This dataset is the same data that powers the price pages at https://golfpriceai.com/prices/.

**What's included**

- **golf-prices-uk.csv**: one row per model (drivers, fairway woods, hybrids, iron sets, wedges, putters, golf balls, golf bags, package sets, junior sets, GPS watches, rangefinders, electric trolleys and launch monitors), with today's lowest new, in-stock UK price, how many retailers stock it, how long we've tracked it, its lowest and highest tracked price, and a plain verdict on whether today's price is good.
- **golf-price-history-uk.csv**: every change in each model's lowest new price since tracking began in August 2026.

**How it's collected**

- Prices come from retailers' own product feeds, checked every 6 hours.
- New, in-stock items only. Second-hand and ex-demo stock is never included.
- Golf ball prices are converted to a price per dozen so pack sizes compare fairly.
- Models are matched across retailers by brand, model name and type. A model only gets a row once it has enough history to be reliable.

**Columns: golf-prices-uk.csv**

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| date | Date of this snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| model_id | Stable ID for the model (also its page address) |
| model | Model name |
| brand | Brand |
| category | driver, fairway wood, hybrid, iron set, wedge, putter, golf ball, golf bag, package set, junior golf set, GPS watch, rangefinder, electric trolley, launch monitor |
| lowest_new_price_gbp | Lowest new, in-stock UK price today, in pounds |
| price_unit | "each", or "per dozen" for golf balls |
| retailers | Number of UK retailers stocking it new today |
| days_tracked | Days of price history we hold |
| tracked_low_gbp | Lowest price we've recorded |
| tracked_high_gbp | Highest price we've recorded |
| verdict | good (at or near its lowest tracked price), typical, or wait (higher than usual, worth waiting) |
| price_page | Link to the model's price page |

**Columns: golf-price-history-uk.csv**

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| model_id | Matches model_id in golf-prices-uk.csv |
| date | Date the lowest price changed |
| lowest_new_price_gbp | The new lowest price from that date |

**Updates**

The files on golfpriceai.com are rebuilt every 6 hours. This copy is refreshed weekly; for the very latest figures, download them from https://golfpriceai.com/prices/data/

Free to use, including commercially, under CC BY 4.0. Please credit "GolfPrice AI (golfpriceai.com)" with a link.

**Ideas for use**

Seasonal price patterns (are golf clubs cheaper in winter?), how prices fall after new models launch, Black Friday discounts compared with genuine price history, brand price comparisons, and price-tracking or forecasting models.
